verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Pipedream Connect handles OAuth/key-based auth and per-end-user account connections (external_user_id, accountId) so agents can call APIs on users' behalf. It does not document issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent, such as permission-limited tokens or per-agent API keys. Managed end-user auth is an adjacent capability, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
